# volcano_project_auth_page_layout (Resource)

The layout for one of a project's hosted auth pages. Read back via the appearance endpoint since this has no GET of its own.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_project_auth_page_layout" "login" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
  page_type  = "login"
  layout     = "split-left"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `layout` (String)
- `page_type` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_project_auth_page_layout.login <project-id>,<page-type>
```
